thread.title: Qorvo, Apple Supplier, Rebounds Despite Weak Forecast

author: Tiernan Ray
title: Qorvo, Apple Supplier, Rebounds Despite Weak Forecast
text:
[Updates with price change after-hours at bottom of post.]
Shares of wireless chip maker Qorvo ( QRVO ) predawn 52 cents, or 0.7%, at $71.25, after the company this afternoon reported fiscal Q3 revenue and profit that topped analysts' expectations, but projected revenue this quarter well below consensus.
CEO Bob Bruggeworth called the quarter just ended "exceptional," noting a "strong ramp support of our largest customer," a node to Apple ( AAPL ). He added that the "near-term market demand has weakened in handsets."
Qorvo's report comes a day before Apple's own fiscal Q1 report, amidst continued hand-wringing about the outlook for iPhone sales this quarter.
Revenue in the three months ended in December rose 2%, year over year, to $845.7 million, yielding EPS of $1.69.
Analysts had been modeling $841 million and $1.60.
For the current quarter, the company sees revenue of $645 million to $665 million, well below the average estimate for $777 million.
Update : Shares have now recovered and are up $2.73, or almost 4%, at $74.50.
